title: SV: Scarlet & Violet Promo Cards #125 Armarouge Ex - Pokemon
descriptionText: The product is a Scarlet & Violet Promo Card #125 featuring Armarouge Ex from the Pokemon franchise, manufactured by Nintendo in 2023. This non-sport trading card is part of a set of promotional cards for the Scarlet & Violet series, with Armarouge Ex being the player/athlete on the card. The card is not autographed and does not contain any memorabilia, making it a desirable collectible for fans of Pokemon trading cards.
